items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return; Cowboys inflate opposing WR scoring 7.3% (most in NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
Jadarian Price OUT (chest); Charbonnet also listed.

items.implication: Commanders QB change; Mariota or other

items.why: ETR list; Levitan noted prior rib too
items.opportunity: if out, boosts other LAC WRs

items.text: Jaylen Warren LOVE: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse role confirmed, soft matchup, short week usage

items.text: Tough run for Jadarian Price: lost GL/base to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest injury, Charbonnet practicing; still passes eye test long-term.
items.why: Multiple role erosions + injury + competition return
items.implication: Avoid short-term; hold for long-term upside
